title: Glowing heart
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff4466" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ff2255" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff2255" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="inner" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff88aa" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff4466" stop-opacity="1"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- outer glow -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="42" fill="url(#glow)" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- heart shape -->
  <path d="M50 78 
           C30 62, 16 48, 16 36 
           C16 24, 26 18, 36 18 
           C43 18, 48 23, 50 28 
           C52 23, 57 18, 64 18 
           C74 18, 84 24, 84 36 
           C84 48, 70 62, 50 78 Z" 
        fill="url(#inner)"/>
  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="32" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#ffccdd" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- small sparkle -->
  <circle cx="62" cy="30" r="2.5" fill="#ffeeff" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="38" r="1.5" fill="#ffeeff" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
